description: Grupo de Ingenieros Civiles Informaticos de primer año de la Autonoma :D
summary: What our team attempted to accomplish, was a simple, and interactive, space navigation game for people of all ages, in which the user must manage the resources of a space ship while logging data from various planets in the solar system, and other galaxies (Note: Galaxies were not implemented, yet).
details:
Our game has the end goal of being a simple, fun, and easy way for people of all ages to learn about the solar system, and other galaxies in the universe. It was made using the Godot Game Engine, coded with GDscript, and with some coding assistance from SI.
Story and art design were user generated.
